description: Job Records: submit two versions of the same terms, policy or agreement text (the version in force at purchase or signing and the current version, each with its effective date where stated) and the comparison date. The signed report splits both into sections, aligns them and lists every changed, added and removed section with a plain buyer-impact label: price or fee, refund or cancellation, liability or dispute, term or renewal, or removed, with a single changed figure named before and after. Two-version comparison: one document’s evidence is wever_terms-evidence-check and contract redlining is wever_contract-diff-check. Verdict buyer_impact_changes, other_changes_only or no_changes. POST /api/terms-change-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, wallet or merchant lookup, order, payment or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/job-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/job-records/.

comparison_date.description: The date of the comparison, as YYYY-MM-DD.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

text.description: The version in force at purchase or signing.
